Scan subdirectories for outdated GitHub Actions workflow versions

Source: R/workflow-updates.R
workflow_updates.Rd

Walks subdirectories of root up to max_depth levels deep, finds any that contain both a README.md and a .github/workflows/ directory, and reports every uses: reference whose version tag is older than the highest version of the same action observed anywhere in the scan.

workflow_updates(root = ".", max_depth = 2L)

Arguments

root

Root directory to search. Defaults to the current working directory (".").

max_depth

Maximum directory depth to descend below root. Passed directly to find -maxdepth. Defaults to 2L.

Value

A tibble with columns action, latest, current, and location describing every outdated uses: reference found, invisibly. Returns an empty tibble (also invisibly) when all references are up to date or no workflow files are found.

Details

Directories (or whole subtrees) can be silently skipped by listing their paths - one per line - in a .workflow-update-excludes file located in root.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Scan two levels deep from the current directory
workflow_updates()

# Scan a specific path, one level deep
workflow_updates("~/projects", max_depth = 1L)
} # }
